llm.summary: This is a coherent Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill with disclosed classroom data use and no executable or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is intentionally designed for Mainland China Chinese K12 chemistry contexts, so use outside that context requires localization of curriculum, language, and crisis channels.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON reference files only; I found no executable scripts, install hooks, dependency installation, or remote payload retrieval instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions define when to activate, route unrelated tasks to other skills, require teacher review, limit student-facing use, and include crisis and lab-safety boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It references platform memory and file capabilities for class workspace data, but writes are limited to teacher-confirmed lesson-plan entries and it provides view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing-control, and export controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is clearly scoped to chemistry lesson-plan drafting for teachers, including curriculum alignment, class timing, weakness data, and safety-level placement for experiments.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for Chinese-language K12 chemistry lesson planning, and localize curriculum references, emergency resources, and consent rules before using it in another region. Teachers should review all generated lesson plans and verify any experiment placement against school safety rules before classroom use.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The locale-specific guidance in shared/platform-conventions.md is explicit: it states the package is for Mainland China Chinese K12 scenarios and warns operators to localize help channels, curriculum assumptions, and legal settings for other regions.
[SQP-3] expected: The exam-help rule in shared/hint-ladder.md cites a China K12 AI-use guideline, but this is consistent with the skill's declared Chinese education deployment rather than hidden global policy manipulation.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language schema descriptions in shared/class-teaching-workspace.schema.json match the disclosed Chinese teacher workflow and do not add unrelated authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese enum values for grade bands and teaching taxonomy are locale-specific data-contract choices; they may reduce portability but are not security-mismatched for this skill.
